sources.citation: Seshat Global History Databank (2026). Cliopatria: a comprehensive geospatial dataset of world polities, version 0.2.0 (released 16 May 2026), cliopatria.geojson. CC BY 4.0. Changes made here: polygons for the Holy Roman Empire and their neighbours were extracted for 12 snapshot years, simplified with mapshaper 0.7.69 (Visvalingam, 15% of vertices kept), rounded to 0.01 degrees, and given shortened, translated labels. Where marked, the empire is drawn as the union of the Cliopatria polities that were imperial estates, clipped to the empire's 1453 extent in Cliopatria less the Teutonic Order's Prussia, because from 1459 Cliopatria files only the small imperial states under the empire's name.
Bennett, James S., Mutch, Erin, Tollefson, Andrew, Chalstrey, Ed, et al. (2025). "Cliopatria: a geospatial database of world-wide political entities from 3400 BCE to 2024 CE." Scientific Data 12.
Seshat Global History Databank. Cliopatria releases on Zenodo (concept record 13363121).
